changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: feedback delivery states already admit UNCONFIRMED
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chk_feedback_state' AND conrelid = 'feedback'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%UNCONFIRMED%'

changeSet.comment: Admit UNCONFIRMED: conversation feedback a turn linked without recording what it said about it.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Conversation feedback is delivered only when its turn showed the feedback's words. A turn before that stored just the observation id, so what it said about the feedback is unknown: UNCONFIRMED, never re-prepared, because the developer may already have been told. Its delivery time goes with the claim; the placement keeps when the turn linked it, which is also the time a rollback restores.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE feedback f SET delivery_state = 'UNCONFIRMED', delivered_at = NULL WHERE f.channel = 'IN_CHAT' AND f.delivery_state = 'DELIVERED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM feedback_placement fp JOIN chat_message cm ON cm.id = fp.chat_message_id JOIN feedback_observation fo ON fo.feedback_id = f.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(cm.parts) = 'array' THEN cm.parts ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS part WHERE fp.feedback_id = f.id AND fp.placement_type = 'CONVERSATION_TURN' AND part ->> 'type' = 'data-observation' AND part -> 'data' ->> 'observationId' = fo.observation_id::text AND btrim(coalesce(part -> 'data' ->> 'text', '')) <> '')
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE feedback f SET delivery_state = 'DELIVERED', delivered_at = ( SELECT min(fp.created_at) FROM feedback_placement fp WHERE fp.feedback_id = f.id AND fp.placement_type = 'CONVERSATION_TURN') WHERE f.delivery_state = 'UNCONFIRMED'
